slides.headline: Test your business idea before you spend a cent.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: AI will almost always say yes. It is a very agreeable assistant.
slides.right:
Ask for evidence,
risks and tests.
slides.right_sub: Make it find holes, not compliments.

slides.label: Question 1
slides.title: Who pays?
slides.card: Who exactly would pay for this, and what do they use today? Be specific.

slides.label: Question 2
slides.title: Why does it fail?
slides.card: Give me the 5 most likely reasons this fails. Rank them by risk.

slides.label: Question 3
slides.title: Cheapest test
slides.card: What is the cheapest way to test this in 7 days? No code, no big budget.

slides.label: Question 4
slides.title: Customer questions
slides.card: Write 10 questions I can ask real customers. No leading questions.

slides.label: Question 5
slides.title: One-page offer
slides.card: Turn this into a one-page offer: problem, solution, price, first customer.
slides.note: Then talk to 5 real people. AI can't do that for you.

slides.headline: Save this before your next idea.

scenes.headline: Your inbox is not a to-do list.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here are my last 20 emails. Sort them into: Reply today, Reply this week, Delegate, Ignore. For each 'Reply today', give a one-line reason and a draft reply in my style. Ask me if anything is unclear.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Write the ones that matter first.

scenes.note: Remove names and private details before you paste.
scenes.text: Send this to someone with 300 unread emails.
